name: services/phones/phone_number

arguments.name: phone_id
arguments.description: Identifier of a phone in database

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • number - a string with the phone number, exactly as it is stored in the database.

    Please note, that it may contain spaces, dashes, parentheses and various other special characters, and sometimes even notes with complex utf-8 characters! This field is not guaranteed to contain a valid phone number (although it should!).

  • comment - a LangDict object, optional comment;

  • phone_type - phone type of selected phone number.

    This field references objects returned by phone_type method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

result_fields.name: number
result_fields.description: Please note, that it may contain spaces, dashes, parentheses and various other special characters, and sometimes even notes with complex utf-8 characters! This field is not guaranteed to contain a valid phone number (although it should!).

result_fields.name: phone_type
result_fields.description: phone type of selected phone number
